  me {
    thLegacyCognitoId

      ...UserDetailsFragment

  }

fragment UserDetailsFragment on UserDetails {
  adsPersonalizationOptOut
  name
  dob
  phoneNumber
  phoneVerified
  email
  emailVerified
  promotionalEmails
  isoCountryCode
  zipcode
  defaultAccountIdentifier
  defaultFdAccountId
  defaultPaymentAccountId
  defaultReloadAmt
  autoReloadEnabled
  autoReloadThreshold
  deliveryAddresses {
    addressLine1
    addressLine2
    city
    country
    phoneNumber
    route
    state
    streetNumber
    zip
    latitude
    longitude
    __typename
  }
  communicationPreferences {
    id
    value
    __typename
  }
  favoriteStores {
    storeId
    storeNumber
    __typename
  }
  loyaltyTier
  __typename
}"}

  adsPersonalizationOptOut

  }

  }

  me {
    thLegacyCognitoId

  adsPersonalizationOptOut
  name
  dob
  phoneNumber
  phoneVerified
  email
  emailVerified
  promotionalEmails

    addressLine1

    city
    country
    phoneNumber
    route
    state
    streetNumber
    zip

    longitude

  }

    id
    value
    __typename
  }
  favoriteStores {
    storeId
    storeNumber
    __typename
  }
  loyaltyTier
  __typename
